JUST IN | The Consulate General of the Philippines in New York said they are monitoring developments on a tourist bus accident along New York’s I-90 highway. New York State Police have reported that several of the casualties are Filipinos.

“Respecting the privacy of the individuals, authorities have not released further information and instead relayed that they will be reaching out to the families of the victims directly,” the statement reads.

The Consulate also reaffirmed its commitment to monitoring developments related to the accident and those needing support.

“For the victims of the accident or their next of kin, the Consulate can be reached at the Assistance-to-Nationals Hotline (917) 294-0196,” the statement added. | via Katrina Manubay

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI
